name: Cotton
read: Cotton Jan 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 79.51, 29 days to expiry 2026-12-18): at-the-money implied vol 20.5%, +2.7 pts vs 2026-11-13. 20-day realized vol 18.5%, so options trade at a premium of 2.0 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +0.6 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-19) call open interest fell 115,903 and puts fell 76,183; put/call OI 0.51 → 0.42, front futures 82.79 → 79.51. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +6,092 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 21.6% → 20.5%. Largest Jan 27 strikes: 80 calls (1,461 lots) and 82 puts (2,834). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 85 calls +1,294; Jan 27 80 calls +1,250. Biggest cut: May 27 115 calls -2,755.
